answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is locked before it can submit work, then slash that bond when independent audits prove fraud or duplicate identities. A Sybil attacker can still create thousands of accounts, but cannot make them credible for free: every identity ties up capital, and detected deception destroys part of it. Auditors can echo one another’s evidence across the dune of submissions, while a ridge of unrelated reviewers makes collusion harder; the cost is funding many bonds and risking them all.
